abilities.stats: 15% current health self-damage; 100 total regen; +3m move speed; 4.5s; 1 charge

abilities.name: Aura of Suffering
abilities.desc: Channeled aura that damages nearby enemies and Victor over time, ramping up the longer it runs.
abilities.stats: 13-58 DPS (x0.15-0.72 scaling); 8m radius

abilities.name: Shocking Reanimation
abilities.desc: Passive that revives Victor after a short channel when he takes lethal damage, shocking and stunning nearby enemies.
abilities.stats: 3s channel; revive at 50% health; 200 spirit damage (x2); 1.5s stun; 18m radius; 3s slow

vindicta.role: Mobile, powerful marksman who engages from range with a crow, flight and a scoped rifle.

abilities.name: Stake
abilities.desc: Throws a stake that tethers enemies near where it lands, limiting how far they can move, while damaging and slowing them.
abilities.stats: 9m radius; 40 spirit damage; 40% slow; 1.75s tether

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.desc: Takes to the air for a while, gaining extra bullet damage and item range while airborne.
abilities.stats: 13s duration; +10 spirit damage per bullet; +50% item range; 0.2s channel

abilities.name: Crow Familiar
abilities.desc: Sends out a crow that hits enemies, lowers their resistances and applies a health-percentage bleed.
abilities.stats: 40 impact damage; -6% bullet/spirit resist each; bleed 2.2% current health/s for 5s

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.desc: Fires a charged scoped hitscan shot that deals bonus damage to wounded targets; kills grant weapon damage stacks.
abilities.stats: 2 charges; 90 spirit damage; up to +90 below 50% health; 1s charge; 6% weapon damage per kill

viscous.role: Evasive Disruptor Gooey: a psychic sea anemone who protects allies and disrupts enemies.

abilities.name: Splatter
abilities.desc: Hurls a bouncing goo blob that leaves slowing puddles where it lands.
abilities.stats: 55 damage (x0.7); 2 bounces; 5m radius; 10s puddles; -28% move speed

abilities.name: The Cube
abilities.desc: Encases a target in protective goo that makes them invulnerable and heals them, but they can't act.
abilities.stats: 40 HP regen (x0.3); 3s; 20m cast range

abilities.name: Puddle Punch
abilities.desc: Raises a goo fist that knocks enemies up, damages and slows them.
abilities.stats: 57.8 melee damage (x0.6); 4m radius; -24% move speed for 3s; 40m range; 1 charge per 1.7s

abilities.name: Goo Ball
abilities.desc: Turns Viscous into a big bouncing ball that damages and stuns on impact and grants resistance.
abilities.stats: 110 damage (x1.0); 0.5s stun; 35% bullet and spirit resist; 11s duration

vyper.role: Gunner Slippery Rat-a-Tat: a mobile gunner focused on evasion and burst damage.

abilities.name: Screwjab Dagger
abilities.desc: Throws a dagger whose damage and slow grow with each hit on the same target.
abilities.stats: 50 spirit damage (+25/stack); -28% move speed (-12%/stack); max 3 stacks; 2 charges

abilities.name: Lethal Venom
abilities.desc: Injects venom that detonates after a delay, hitting harder the lower the target's health is.
abilities.stats: 20-140 spirit damage; 10m range; 3s buildup

abilities.name: Slither
abilities.desc: Passive that improves sliding with more distance, uphill ability and tighter turning.
abilities.stats: +15% slide distance; 14.7 m/s slide speed

abilities.name: Petrifying Bola
abilities.desc: Throws a bola that slows and damages in an area; a direct hit petrifies the target instead.
abilities.stats: 50 explosion damage; 180 petrify damage; 2.2s petrify; 12m radius; -40% slow for 1.5s

warden.role: A tough, tenacious brawler with endless determination and a knack for alchemy.

abilities.name: Alchemical Flask
abilities.desc: Throws a flask that damages enemies and weakens their gun damage and movement speed.
abilities.stats: 60 damage (x0.63); 5.5m radius; -25% weapon damage; -16% move speed

abilities.name: Willpower
abilities.desc: Gives Warden a barrier and a short movement speed boost.
abilities.stats: 125 barrier (x0.8); +15% move speed; 5s

abilities.name: Binding Word
abilities.desc: Curses an enemy hero, who is damaged and immobilized if they don't get away in time.
abilities.stats: 110 damage (x2.44); 15m range; 1.75s immobilize; 2.8s escape time

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.desc: Channels briefly with damage resistance, then releases pulses that damage enemies and heal Warden.
abilities.stats: 70 DPS (x1.3); 12m radius; 75% hero lifesteal; 50% resist during 2s channel; 6s duration

wraith.role: A fast-talking, fast-firing combatant with strong offense and mobility.

abilities.name: Card Trick
abilities.desc: Conjures random playing cards to throw at enemies, each suit applying a different effect.
abilities.stats: 45 spirit damage; 500m cast range; 2 charges

abilities.name: Project Mind
abilities.desc: Teleports Wraith to a targeted spot, optionally granting a barrier.
abilities.stats: 25m cast range; 0.8s channel; 300 barrier at T2

abilities.name: Full Auto
abilities.desc: Temporarily raises fire rate and adds spirit damage to each bullet.
abilities.stats: +20% fire rate; 2 spirit damage per bullet; 5s

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.desc: Lifts an enemy hero into the air and slams them toward a chosen spot, damaging and slowing them.
abilities.stats: 1.25s channel; 10m range; 100 spirit damage; 1.25s stun; -32% move speed

yamato.role: Close-range assassin using precise strikes and sword attacks.

abilities.name: Power Slash
abilities.desc: Channels to build up a sword strike that can be released early for less damage, resisting bullets while casting.
abilities.stats: 145 spirit damage (x1.85); 22m range; 1.4s full charge; 60% bullet resist

abilities.name: Flying Slash
abilities.desc: Fires a grappling hook that pulls Yamato to an enemy, hitting and slowing them on arrival.
abilities.stats: 66 melee damage (x1.2); -40% move speed for 2.5s; 26m range

abilities.name: Crimson Slash
abilities.desc: Slashes enemies in front, damaging them and cutting their fire rate; heals Yamato on hero hits.
abilities.stats: 55 spirit damage (x0.37); -30% fire rate for 4s; 13m radius; heals 55 (x1.04)

abilities.name: Shadow Transformation
abilities.desc: After a short channel, Yamato becomes a shadow with faster abilities, resistances and immunity to negative effects.
abilities.stats: 1.5s channel; 5s; +60% ability speed; 30% bullet/spirit resist; kill heals 15% max HP, +2s

deadman-danny.role: Reckless, high-flying, explosive aggressive airborne combatant

abilities.name: Strix Salvo
abilities.desc: Fires a line of spirit missiles that lodge in the ground and burst on a timer or when an enemy comes close, marking whoever they hit. Charged shots on marked enemies deal bonus damage and slow.

abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
abilities.desc: Hold jump to fly on the jetpack while it heats up; at max heat Danny dives, and the landing explodes and launches nearby enemies. Missing every hero stuns Danny instead.

abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
abilities.desc: Sprays fuel that burns enemies and shreds bullet resist, building to a big backblast that deals spirit damage and pushes Danny backwards.

abilities.name: Close The Deal
abilities.desc: Grabs an enemy, rockets high into the air and slams back down; both take damage on the way, more against enemies on low health.

nurse-harrow.role: Strict, terrifying savior with a medical theme and an automatic weapon

abilities.name: Setup Bishop
abilities.desc: Places a bishop that stays on the board. Moving it slows and damages enemies along its path, then lights diagonal squares that hurt anyone stepping on them.

abilities.name: Kingside Knight
abilities.desc: Promotes an ally to a knight with bonus stamina and a barrier, or crowns Solomon as king for a double barrier. Moving the piece makes it invulnerable until it lands.

abilities.name: Rook Battery
abilities.desc: Sends a pair of rooks forward that damage and immobilise enemies and bounce back off walls. Recast to split them sideways.

abilities.name: Develop Queen
abilities.desc: Drops a queen that crashes down for area damage, then fires squares in straight lines that hit again and stun. Moving her leaps to a new spot and repeats the effects.

abilities.name: Living Ink
abilities.desc: Empowers the next three bullets so they can be steered in flight for extra damage and splash; hero hits cut all ability cooldowns. Aiming instead paints a solid ink wall that blocks shots and movement.

abilities.name: Flow State
abilities.desc: Drags a brush forward that leaves a trail: allies slide further on it, enemies crossing it are slowed and damaged. Recast to flick the brush for a wider burst.

abilities.name: Still Life
abilities.desc: Picks an enemy hero as a subject and damages them while Violet keeps looking; a finished sketch stuns them and drops a sketch she can collect for permanent stats.

abilities.name: Abstract Landscape
abilities.desc: Paints a ring of ink that blocks vision and gives allies spirit power; enemies inside are revealed, and leaving it damages, silences and slows them.

rat-king.role: Scrappy, regal, tenacious rat monarch with grenade slows, rat-swarm shred, reflective armor and a team banner ult

abilities.name: Scrap Grenade
abilities.desc: Hurl a scrap grenade that blows up several times in a row, dealing bullet damage and slowing enemies in the blast area.
abilities.stats: 3 detonations x 70 dmg; 8m radius; -20% move speed for 4s

abilities.name: Rat Swarm
abilities.desc: Summon rats that jump onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and lowering their bullet resist with each bite.
abilities.stats: 50m cast range; 10m radius; 6s; 8 dmg/bite; -1% bullet resist/bite; max 5 rats; 8s charge cooldown

abilities.name: Royal Pestments
abilities.desc: Put on scrap armor that grants a barrier from your max health; while it holds, incoming bullets may be reflected back at attackers.
abilities.stats: 6s; barrier 15% max HP; 15% bullet return chance

abilities.name: Rule, Ratannia!
abilities.desc: Charge up and slam down the banner of Ratannia; nearby allies gain move speed, slow immunity and damage reduction while near it.
abilities.stats: 10s; 20m radius; +3 m/s; 15% damage reduction; slam 200 dmg, -40% slow; flag lasts 12s
